Write TRUE if the statement is correct and FALSE if the statement is not correct. (i) God rested on the seventh day. (ii) Abel was a farmer. (iii) The serpent was more crafty than any other beast. (iv) Adam and Eve were clothed in animal skins by God. (v) The flood covered the tops of the highest mountains. (vi) Noah was six hundred years old when the flood came. (vii) The ark was made of gopher wood. (ix) God saw that the wickedness of man was great. (x) The heavens and earth were created in ten days. (xi) Eve was made from the rib of Adam. (xii) Lamech was the first man to have two wives. (xiii) The Gihon is a river that flows through Eden. (xiv) Noah sent out a raven three times. (xv) The ark had three decks. (xvi) Adam lived for 930 years. (xvii) Sin entered the world through the disobedience of man. (xviii) God put a mark on Cain to protect him. (xix) The name Eve means mother of all living. (xx) Enoch was the son of Jared.

Give short answers to the following questions. (i) List three specific things God created on the sixth day. (ii) Mention two reasons why God decided to bring the flood upon the earth. (iii) In Genesis 4:9 the Lord asked a question to Cain. (a) What was the question? (b) What was the answer Cain gave? (c) What does this answer reveal about the character of Cain? (iv) Explain the meaning of the name Noah. (v) Identify two ways in which man is created in the image of God. (vi) Describe the instructions God gave to Noah regarding the animals for the ark. (a) How many of each clean animal? (b) How many of each unclean animal? (vii) What were the two special trees in the middle of the garden? (viii) Briefly state the consequence of the confusion of languages at Babel. (ix) Give the names of the two sons of Lamech by his wife Adah. Page 5 of 6 Find this and other free resources at: https://maktaba.tetea.org Find this and other free resources at: https://maktaba.tetea.org (x) Why did God banish Adam and Eve from the garden?

Give short answers to the following questions. (i) I will surely die if I eat of it. (a) Who thought or spoke these words in the context of the temptation? (b) To which tree was this referring? (c) Who told the lie that they would not die? (d) What was the actual spiritual result of eating the fruit? (ii) Am I my brothers keeper? (a) Identify the speaker of these words. (b) To whom were they spoken? (c) What had the speaker just done? (d) What lesson do we learn about our responsibility to others? (iii) Describe the three parts of the punishment given to the serpent in Genesis 3. (iv) Mention two promises God made to Noah after he came out of the ark. (v) The sons of God saw that the daughters of man were beautiful. (a) What was the result of this union? (b) How did God react to the state of the world at that time? (vi) List the four rivers that flowed out of Eden. (vii) Briefly explain the meaning of the Sabbath day as established in Genesis 2. (viii) What was the mark of Cain and what was its purpose? (ix) Mention two similarities between the flood of Noah and the original creation. (x) What are three benefits of living a life that walks with God like Enoch?
